Interface JlmRuntime

public interface JlmRuntime
What the language-model engine needs from the board: memory for a model and its cache, and random numbers.

  • Method Summary

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    add(float[] target, float[] source, int n)
    Adds source[0..n) to target, element by element.
    @Nullable ModelMemory
    allocate(int bytes)
    A zeroed block of bytes, or null when it does not fit.
    @Nullable ModelMemory
    bundledModel()
    A fresh copy of the model the compiler linked into the firmware, or null when it does not fit.
    void
    exponentials(float[] values, int count, float shift, float cutoff)
    Sets each of the first count values to 0 when it is below cutoff, and otherwise to e^(value - shift) in single precision: the softmax exponentials, which in Java's double-precision Math.exp would dominate the engine's time on a board without a double-precision unit.
    float
    nextFloat()
    A uniformly distributed float in [0, 1), for sampling.
    void
    relu(float[] x, int n)
    Sets every negative value of x[0..n) to 0.
    void
    rmsNorm(float[] x, float[] gains, int gainOffset, float[] y, int n)
    RMS-normalizes x[0..n) into y: each value times 1 / sqrt(mean of squares + 1e-5) times gains[gainOffset + i].
